plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: DUO reads your weight and body readings, for example from your Fitdays scale, to track your goals. This stays on your phone.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: DUO uses your location to measure distance and pace on walks and runs.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: DUO keeps measuring your walk or run while the screen is locked.
